title: Unbounded derived direct-image cohomology as sheafified local hypercohomology
statement:
Let $f:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Work with module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on the sites of open subsets with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], in a common universe containing the spaces, their opens and the module values [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, the unbounded cochain derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The direct image is $(f_*F)(V)=F(f^{-1}V)$ with the $\mathcal O_Y(V)$-action induced by $f^\sharp$; its unbounded right derived functor $Rf_*$ is computed by applying $f_*$ termwise to a K-injective representative [def-sfb-right-derived-functor, def-pur-kinjective-complex]. For an open $W$ of a ringed space $T$ and $M\in D(\mathcal O_T)$, write $H^q(W,M)=H^q(R\Gamma(W,M))$, where $R\Gamma(W,-)$ is the unbounded right derived functor of evaluation $F\mapsto F(W)$, followed by forgetting scalars, computed on a K-injective representative. Then for every integer $q$ there is a canonical isomorphism of abelian presheaves on $Y$:
$$\bigl(V\mapsto H^q(f^{-1}V,E)\bigr)\cong\bigl(V\mapsto H^q(V,Rf_*E)\bigr).$$
The sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of either presheaf is canonically the underlying abelian sheaf of $\mathcal H^q(Rf_*E)$. The comparisons are natural in $E$ and compatible with restriction to smaller opens. No boundedness, quasi-compactness, or scheme hypothesis is imposed.
